summary: Independently verifies Phase 145G.2's IWPC-001 v1.1 -> v1.2 contract diff, state machine, option-presentation binding, replay/mutation behavior, persistence/corruption handling, application-layer ownership, CLI-adapter thinness, and the preview -> AwaitingConfirmation transition repair, using two parallel research passes that each re-derived expected behavior from contract text and git history before consulting Phase 145G.2's own report or trusting its tests as proof. F-145G.1-1 (no command transitioned a session out of AwaitingDecision) is independently confirmed closed: select provides a real production path, and a genuine, subprocess-separated, CLI-only reproduction reaches create -> select -> preview -> confirm -> readiness -> publish with no direct construction or fixture bridging anywhere. Every mechanism Phase 145G.2 itself built passed adversarial re-verification without a new defect of its own. This phase's own independent verification nonetheless found a new Blocking finding (F-145G.2V-1, not the finding 145G.2 was scoped to check): no command in the decision-session family -- select newly included -- enforces IWC-REQ-022/IWC-REQ-151's explicit 'resumed only by the identity bound at creation' requirement; no channel exists anywhere in the CLI to even supply a competing identity claim, so the requirement is silently unenforceable. This predates Phase 145G.2 (already true for confirm/preview/clarify/cancel) but was not previously disclosed against these two specific requirements, and select extends the same unenforced pattern to a new, irreversible, state-mutating command. Per this verification phase's own governing rules, identity/authority defects may never be downgraded to Non-Blocking regardless of which phase introduced them, so the overall verdict is NOT VERIFIED -- BLOCKING FINDINGS despite F-145G.1-1's own closure being sound. Three further Non-Blocking findings are also recorded: duplicate-option/empty-template-version rejection is CLI-argparse-only, not domain-re-validated (currently unreachable in production since the CLI is the sole v1.0 input channel); no cross-field invariant ties persisted session_state to human_selection_id's presence on deserialization (only reachable via direct file tampering outside every governed boundary); and pre-existing application/domain layering debt in transition-sequencing bookkeeping. No production code was modified. Repair was not attempted: closing F-145G.2V-1 requires a design decision (what identity-claim channel to add, and to how many commands) this phase's own governing prompt forbids inventing. 51 fresh adversarial/e2e tests were added (tests/test_phase_145g2v_independent_verification.py, tests/test_phase_145g2v_independent_verification_partial.py), all passing; full existing regression across 145D-145G.2 (322+28 tests) and fast_green (4391 tests) confirmed unaffected. See docs/PHASE_145G2V_INTERACTIVE_WORKFLOW_DECISION_SELECTION_CONTRACT_AND_IMPLEMENTATION_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.md.
